name: Turn to Stone
tagline: Cracks race across your skin and you petrify into a marble statue.
subject: the person
endFrame: Convert {subject} into a classical carved white marble statue with grey veining: skin, hair and clothing become chiselled stone with fine cracks and a dusty matte surface, eyes blank and smooth. Keep the exact same pose, framing, camera angle, background and lighting; keep {subject}'s face shape and proportions recognisable.
motion: {subject} freezes mid-breath. Grey stone texture blooms from the chest outward, fine cracks racing across the skin and clothing as colour drains away. Hair stiffens into carved strands, a puff of stone dust drifts down, and {subject} settles into a still white marble statue. The camera slowly pushes in.
sound: deep grinding stone, crackling fractures, and a low echoing rumble that settles into silence
author: Conjure
